task: How much did US quarterly real GDP growth for 2023–2024 change between the first recorded print and the latest revised value? Compare the two by quarter.
context: Use quarter-on-quarter annualized growth in percent, with the native source documenting the same definition for both versions.
First recorded print is the supported native first-vintage product, not a promise of immutable real-time publication timestamps. Publish the requested answer only.

outputs.name: gdp_revisions
outputs.description: One row per available calendar quarter in 2023–2024; preserve the native clock and any vintage limitations.

schema.name: first_growth
schema.description: First recorded quarterly real GDP growth, annualized.

schema.name: latest_growth
schema.description: Latest revised quarterly real GDP growth, annualized.
